title: Alaska’s freighter expansion puts Hawaii cargo growth in focus
content:
Alaska Air Group is doubling its dedicated freighter fleet as it looks to unlock cargo demand in Hawaii and build a more substantial international freight business.
However, the challenge might be turning that additional aircraft capacity into sustainable revenue growth.
The airline plans to introduce four Boeing 737-800 converted freighters in the first half of next year, increasing its dedicated narrowbody fleet from five to nine aircraft.
